approval_scope: The four rules shown in the preceding reply and independent resolution per monster; unshown implementation details remain pending.

accepted_rules.already_provoked: Keep the current Guardian and remaining duration. Another taunt neither changes the target nor refreshes the effect.
accepted_rules.simultaneous_free_target: Choose the nearest eligible Guardian, with a stable choice in a tie.
accepted_rules.no_stacking: One provocation and one icon per monster, without cumulative effects.
accepted_rules.source_destroyed_or_recalled: End that provocation and resume normal targeting.
accepted_rules.independent_monsters: Resolve each monster separately, allowing several Guardians to attract different enemies.

still_pending: Exact distance metric, stable tie implementation and source eligibility details
Action and cooldown outcome when a Guardian wins no target
Sight loss, path failure, expiration timing, bosses and resistances
Capacity, taunt radius, duration and cooldown numbers
Native taunt animation and exact status icon
